@@@ case 90 (documented valid)

      /**
       * Return a V1 style query identifier.
       *
       * @param {string} id - The query identifier.
       * @returns {string} V1 style query identifier.
       */
      function v1QueryId(id) {
          switch (id) {
              case 'addq':
              case 'aliq':
              case 'locq':
                  return id.substring(3);
              case 'lost':
                  return id.substring(4);
              default:
                  return id;
          }
      }
      
@@@ findings
@@@ case 91 (documented valid)

      /**
       * Parses the required header fields for the given SIP message.
       *
       * @param {string} logPrefix - The log prefix.
       * @param {string} sipMessage - The SIP message.
       * @param {string[]} headers - The header fields to be parsed.
       * @returns {object} Object with parsed header fields.
       */
      function parseSipHeaders(logPrefix, sipMessage, headers) {
          try {
              return esappSip.parseHeaders(sipMessage, headers);
          } catch (err) {
              logger.error(logPrefix, 'Failed to parse');
              return {};
          }
      }

@@@ case 95 (documented valid)

      /**
       * @param {string} name
       *
       * @typedef {void | { loadTime: number; runTime: number; totalTime: number }} PerfResult
       * @returns {PerfResult} Perf result
       */
      const perfCase = name => {
        const loadStartTime = performance.now();

        let syncFn;

        try {
          syncFn = require(`./${name}.cjs`);
        } catch {
          return;
        }

        const loadTime = performance.now() - loadStartTime;

        let i = RUN_TIMES;

        const runStartTime = performance.now();

        while (i-- > 0) {
          syncFn(__filename);
        }

        const runTime = performance.now() - runStartTime;

        return {
          loadTime,
          runTime,
          totalTime: runTime + loadTime,
        };
      };

/** Specification of the story demonstrated by the page. */
const STORY = "docs/backlog/stories/E01-F02-US-007-shape-selector-playground.md";

/**
 * Selects a required element of the page by its id.
 *
 * @kind procedure
 * @param document - page document
 * @param id - `id` attribute, without `#`
 * @returns the HTML element carrying this `id`
 * @throws {Error} when the page has no element with this id
 * @see docs/backlog/stories/E01-F01-US-002-sharp-rectangle-in-playground.md
 */
export function selectElement(document: Document, id: string): HTMLElement {
  const element = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`#${id}`);

  if (element === null) {
    throw new Error(`Playground page without #${id} (${STORY}).`);
  }

}

@@@ case 113 (planted in a copy of a file of the tree)
import { PENDING_TASKS } from "./pending-tasks";

/**
 * Runs a task, its failure handed to `onFailure`.
 *
 * @kind procedure
 * @param task - the work to run
 * @param onFailure - called with the error when the task fails
 * @returns once the task is done or its failure handled
 * @see docs/backlog/stories/E15-F15-US-036-import-choose-and-embed-a-font.md
 */
async function runSettledPlain(
  task: () => Promise<void>,
  onFailure: (error: unknown) => void,
): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await task();
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    onFailure(error);
  }
}

/**
 * Runs an asynchronous task started by an event listener, which returns nothing and cannot await
 * it — a font file read, the fonts the browser lists (US-036): the task's promise is kept with the
 * page's pending tasks (`PENDING_TASKS`), never left floating, and its failure handed to
 * `onFailure`.
 *
 * @kind procedure
 * @param document - page document
 * @param task - the task to run
 * @param onFailure - called with the error when the task fails
 * @see docs/backlog/stories/E15-F15-US-036-import-choose-and-embed-a-font.md
 */
export function runTask(
  document: Document,
  task: () => Promise<void>,
  onFailure: (error: unknown) => void,
): void {
  const running = runSettled(task, onFailure);

  PENDING_TASKS.set(document, [...(PENDING_TASKS.get(document) ?? []), running]);
}
